app.title: Outlook AI Orchestrator
app.refreshHint: Re-analyse this email now (uses one AI call)
app.offline: You are offline. Cached results stay available; new analyses resume automatically.
app.backendUnreachable: The AI Orchestrator is unreachable. Cached results stay available.

summary.phishingSuspicious: This email shows signs of phishing (score {score}%). Do not click links or open attachments before verifying the sender.
summary.phishingLikely: This email is likely a phishing attempt (score {score}%). Do not reply, click links or open attachments. Report it to the Compliance Team.
summary.draftOpened: Reply draft opened — review it before sending.
summary.emptyBody: This email has not been analysed. Analysing it uses one AI call.
summary.emptyResultTitle: The AI returned an empty analysis
summary.emptyResultBody: Nothing could be extracted from this message — it may be a forward with no readable text. Retry to ask the model again.
summary.noSummary: No summary was produced for this email.
summary.degradedBody: The model could not be reached, so this analysis comes from rules alone and is less complete than usual. Retry to ask the model again.

chat.indexHint: Re-indexes the emails opened in this browser. Emails analysed in the pane are indexed automatically; with Microsoft Graph the orchestrator indexes the whole mailbox.
chat.indexedDegraded: {indexed} emails indexed ({skipped} skipped) — search will be keyword-only: {warning}
chat.nothingToIndex: Open a few emails first — nothing to index yet.
chat.empty: Ask anything about your emails, e.g. "Find the email where the client approved the mandate."
chat.openFailed: Could not open the original email.
chat.indexEmpty: No email indexed yet: open or select emails
chat.indexNoGraph: without Microsoft Graph, only the emails opened in the pane or selected are indexed

automation.title: Automation Coach
automation.stats: You do this {perWeek} times a week, ~{minutes} minutes total.
automation.simulateIntro: We'll simulate this automation using your past {count} similar emails.
automation.noProposals: No routine detected yet. Keep working in Outlook — the coach learns from repeated actions.
automation.approved: Automation approved. It is now active.

editor.title: Edit rule (local only)
editor.hint: Changes are kept in this session only — updating automations server-side is not part of the API yet.

compliance.title: Compliance Guardian
compliance.addressIssues: Address the issues below to reduce risk before sending.
compliance.noIssuesHint: This draft complies with the current policy. You can send it.
compliance.escalationSent: Escalation sent, id {id}. Compliance will review your draft.
compliance.actionNotAvailable: This action is not available in this Outlook client.

approval.title: Action Approval Required
approval.introTitle: I've analyzed this email thread and prepared the following actions.
approval.introText: Please review each action before I proceed.
approval.humanValidationText: These actions will only be executed after your approval. All actions are logged for audit and compliance.
approval.noActions: No action proposed for this email.

actions.manualFlag: Flagging is not supported by this Outlook client — please flag the message manually.
actions.manualMove: Use Outlook's "Move to" command to move this message{folder}.
actions.manualLabel: Apply the "{label}" sensitivity label from the Outlook ribbon.
actions.manualGeneric: Please complete this action manually in Outlook.
actions.previewToast: Preview mode: "{operation}" would run in Outlook.
actions.appointmentOpened: Reminder appointment opened — save it to keep the reminder.

errors.title: Something went wrong
errors.network: The AI Orchestrator is unreachable. Check your connection or try again later.
errors.timeout: The request timed out. Please try again.
errors.unauthorized: You are not signed in. Please sign in again.
errors.forbidden: You are not allowed to perform this action.
errors.validation: The request was rejected by the server (validation error).
errors.llm: The AI model is temporarily unavailable. Results may be degraded.
errors.graph: Microsoft Graph is unavailable — the action was returned to the add-in.
errors.officeUnavailable: Office.js is not available — showing sample data.
errors.boundaryTitle: This section could not be displayed
errors.boundaryBody: Something went wrong while rendering {feature}. The rest of the panel still works.

sso.generic: Single sign-on failed. Please close and reopen the panel; if it persists, contact IT with the correlation ID.
sso.13000: Single sign-on is not supported by this Outlook version. Ask your administrator to review the add-in deployment (see the SSO runbook).
sso.13001: You are not signed in to Office. Sign in to Outlook and reopen the panel.
sso.13002: The consent prompt was dismissed. Reopen the panel and accept the permission request.
sso.13003: This account type is not supported for single sign-on. Sign in with your work account.
sso.13004: The add-in registration is invalid. Ask your administrator to check the Application ID URI (see the SSO runbook).
sso.13005: Single sign-on is blocked for this add-in. Ask your administrator to grant admin consent (see the SSO runbook).
sso.13006: A temporary client error occurred. Please try again.
sso.13007: Office could not obtain a token for this add-in. Try again; if it persists, contact IT with the correlation ID.
sso.13008: A sign-in is already in progress. Wait a moment and try again.
sso.13009: Single sign-on could not complete without a prompt. Reopen the panel to sign in.
sso.13010: Single sign-on is not allowed in this browser session. Ask your administrator (see the SSO runbook).
sso.13012: Single sign-on is unavailable in this Outlook client. Contact IT (see the SSO runbook).
sso.13013: Too many sign-in attempts. Wait a minute and try again.

errors.backendBody: The add-in cannot reach the AI Orchestrator, so it has nothing to show. It will not fall back to sample data: an analysis of a sample email is not an answer about your mailbox.
errors.backendHint: Check that the backend is running (npm run dev) and that VITE_API_BASE_URL points at it, then retry.
errors.cancelled: The request was cancelled because you opened another email.

tip.precomputed: Analysed ahead of time by the mailbox sync worker — no AI call was made when you opened this email.
tip.cache: Identical content was already analysed, so the stored result was reused.
tip.local: Served from this device's local cache. Refresh to re-analyse (uses one AI call).
tip.llm: Generated by the AI model for this request.
tip.heuristic: Produced by rules only — no AI model was involved.

triage.savesModel: This email was classified as low-value, so no AI call was made. Analysing it anyway uses one.
triage.stillTriaged: The orchestrator applied its triage rules again and still classified this email as not worth a model call, so no AI call was made. The rule lives in the server policy, not in the panel.

brief.title: Daily brief
brief.subtitle: Daily brief
brief.noPriority: No email needs you right now.
brief.regenerateBody: This asks the AI model for a new brief. The brief shown now was prepared without any extra AI call, so regenerating costs one.
brief.emptyBody: The mailbox sync worker prepares it every morning. You can generate one now — it uses one AI call.
brief.disabled: The daily brief is disabled for your organisation.

sync.title: Mailbox sync
sync.syncNowHint: Asks the sync worker to index and precompute new mail. This does not call the AI model directly.
sync.disabled: Mailbox sync is off: the add-in reads only the email you have open. Ask your administrator to enable Microsoft Graph access to precompute analyses.

settings.title: Settings
settings.telemetryHint: Counts and timings only (which tab you open, how long an analysis took). Email content, subjects, recipients and attachment names are never sent.
settings.cacheHint: Analyses are cached on this device for 24 hours so switching between emails is instant and no extra AI call is made.

home.subtitle: Your mailbox
home.openEmailHint: Open an email to analyse it — summary, risks and proposed actions need a message. Here you get what is mailbox-wide: your daily brief and the chat over your indexed emails.
home.chatEmpty: Ask anything about your mailbox, e.g. "What am I still waiting for from the client?"

selection.title: Selection
selection.empty: Nothing is selected. Select several emails in the list, or open one.
selection.unsupported: Multi-select needs the new Outlook or Outlook on the web.
selection.unsupportedHint: This Outlook version cannot tell an add-in which messages are selected (Mailbox requirement set 1.13). Open a single email instead, or pin the pane and use the daily brief.
selection.degraded: Only {loaded} of {count} messages could be read in full. Outlook did not allow loading the others (Mailbox 1.13 without 1.15), so the synthesis uses their subjects only.
selection.whatNext: What do you want to do?
selection.synthesiseFirst: Actions are proposed from the synthesis — running it first.
selection.costHint: Synthesising and asking use one AI call each. Listing the selection costs nothing.
selection.chatEmpty: Ask a question about the {count} selected emails; retrieval stays inside the selection.

read.noItemBody: Outlook closed the message while the panel was loading it. Open an email to analyse it.
